correctness.rationale: Independent F₂⁴ coset construction generates the twenty affine F₄ lines and the 30, 160 and 190 distinct Boolean concept masks. Direct intersection sets against all 14,893 supports of sizes 0–6 verify the complete criteria, not just totals: P/N/A four counts 1680/1680/1800, five counts 0/2400/3840 and no six. A separate enumeration of all 5,760 affine semilinear maps reproduces every supplied orbit size, representative trace bitset, signature and exhaustive partition through size five. The two single-triple five-orbits are size 960 without a circuit and 1440 with a circuit; only the first is shattered by N. The 1440 double-triple five-supports also shatter for N. A support with four collinear points cannot realize three of them excluding the fourth. A six-support without four collinear points would first need two disjoint triples covering it. Keeping all of one triple forces its carrier in any two-line realization, so keeping two points of the other triple forces that second carrier and makes exclusion of its third point impossible. Heredity closes all higher sizes. The repaired comparison derivations are also checked: binary affine hyperplanes are exactly the parallel unions, and for up to five affine points two avoidance lines ensure that restriction and padding of projective witnesses preserve all unrestricted traces. The exact results in the original were correct; the repair narrows the asserted contribution and clarifies the count of triples to exclude full-line supports.
residual_risks: Finite exhaustive proof for AG(2,4) only. Neither the replay nor the support-count identities validate a general-order or online-learning extrapolation.

evidence: The projective result gives all triple supports, four-sets except four collinear, and for q≥4 the one- and two-triple five-types with no four collinear. The real-plane work gives dimension five and two shattered incidence-isomorphism types.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Projective witnesses restrict to at most two distinct affine lines and can be padded on a small support. This covers A, but the projective result cannot distinguish affine parallel endpoints meeting at infinity or aggregate the two different N outcomes within a single incidence type.

evidence: On five affine points at least two affine lines are vacant: hitting four lines in each direction accounts for one pair per direction, and even one vacancy globally gives at most seven of ten pairs. Thus projective trace witnesses can be padded to distinct affine ones. On the other hand, the 960 and 1440 single-triple supports have identical ordinary collinearity type and different actual N trace sets.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The unrestricted profile and known VC dimensions are credited instead of asserted distinct. Neither the affine nonparallel existence witness nor the projective or real incidence-type theorem implies the N census by restriction or dimension. The retained exact split is new on the checked evidence.

evidence: The parallel class consists of all 30 affine hyperplanes of the binary four-space. The zero-sum criterion on four points is affine independence in that space. The earlier affine records provide static or online dimensions and witness supports.

originality.rationale: The three-way census is not accepted as three independent new invariants. In particular the unrestricted support criterion is a corollary of the previous projective characterization after affine restriction and padding, and the P baseline is ordinary binary affine-hyperplane shattering. The substantive repaired finding is the exact N support profile with the additive-obstruction split and the precise comparison with those baselines. The prior nonparallel theorem attains the dimension but does not determine this profile. The same record match is not a distinct antecedent.
residual_risks: Unknown or unindexed finite-geometry or Boolean concept tables could contain the same N profile. The web query returning general background was non-evidence, not a coverage exclusion.

value.rationale: Order four is the first affine order where both the earlier parallel rank-four and nonparallel rank-five results apply. The useful retained comparison is not a small table of dimensions: N and P have exactly the same shattered four-supports, but N distinguishes two single-triple types that have identical ordinary collinearity via an additive obstruction. This identifies precisely which 1440 of the natural unrestricted five-supports disappear under the nonparallel constraint and gives a test case for finite-field trace criteria.
residual_risks: No asymptotic interpretation or general classification in other affine planes is claimed.
